honest_access_summary: GOG-0218 specimen/germline data are on dbGaP under NRG Oncology submissions; the exact phs accession is confirmed from the dbGaP study report once a DAR is filed (the literal 'GOG-0218' is not a dbGaP search token). No controlled genotype/phenotype files were downloaded here.
